title: Master Syllabus: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) Fundamentals
description: This section builds directly on your HTML5 foundation by introducing Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) to control visual styling, color palettes, layouts, and typography.

master_syllabus.core_topics_covered: Introduction to CSS & Styling Injection Methods (Inline, Embedded, External)
The Cascade: Specificity Rules & Conflicting Styles
Background Styling (Colors, Images, Gradients, and Positioning)

modules.title: Methods of Applying CSS Styles
modules.introduction: CSS can be integrated into your web documents in three distinct ways, ranging from localized overrides to global project sheets.

styling_methods.name: Inline Styles
styling_methods.definition: Applying CSS rules directly to an individual HTML element using the style attribute.
styling_methods.use_case: Quick, temporary testing or dynamic overrides via JavaScript.

syntax_example.code: Welcome to My Styled Page

styling_methods.drawback: Violates the principle of separation of concerns (mixing structure with presentation) and makes large-scale maintenance difficult.

styling_methods.name: Embedded (Internal) Style Sheets
styling_methods.definition: Placing CSS rules within a <style> element inside the <head> section of an HTML document.
styling_methods.scope: Affects all matching elements within that single HTML page.
styling_methods.use_case: Single-page landing pages or unique styles meant exclusively for one document.

syntax_example.code:
<head>
    <style>
        body {
            background-color: #f7fafc;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            color: #2d3748;
        }
        h2 {
            border-bottom: 2px solid #cbd5e0;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
        }
    </style>
</head>

styling_methods.name: Linking External Style Sheets (Industry Standard)
styling_methods.definition: Writing CSS rules in a separate file with a .css extension and linking it to HTML documents using the <link> tag inside the <head>.
styling_methods.scope: Affects multiple pages across an entire website, ensuring global design consistency.
benefits: Faster page load times (via browser caching)

modules.title: The Cascade & Conflicting Styles
modules.introduction: When multiple style rules target the same HTML element, the browser determines which rule wins through The Cascade mechanism, governed by Specificity and Source Order.

topics.name: The Cascade Hierarchy (Specificity Score)
topics.description: Rules are weighted and prioritized in the following order (from lowest to highest priority):
hierarchy: Browser Default Styles: The baseline styling built into Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.
External & Embedded Style Sheets: Rules defined in .css files or <style> blocks.
Inline Styles: Defined directly on the element via the style="..." attribute (overrides external/embedded styles unless !important is used).
The !important Declaration: Overrides all normal rules, but should be used sparingly because it makes debugging difficult.

topics.name: Source Order Rule
topics.description: If two conflicting rules have the exact same specificity (e.g., two class selectors applied to the same element), the rule written last in the stylesheet takes precedence.

modules.title: Backgrounds
modules.introduction: CSS provides rich properties to style element backgrounds, transforming flat layouts into visually engaging interfaces.

properties.name: Background Color (background-color)
properties.description: Sets a solid color background using names (tomato), HEX codes (#ff5733), RGB (rgb(255, 87, 51)), or HSL.

properties.name: Background Images (background-image)
properties.description: Applies raster graphics or SVGs to an element's background.

properties.name: Controlling Background Behavior
properties.description: To prevent layout distortion and ensure clean design, CSS provides companion properties:

companion_properties.background-size: Controls image scaling (cover scales the image to completely cover the container; contain scales the image to fit entirely inside without cropping).
companion_properties.background-position: Controls alignment (center, top right, bottom left).
companion_properties.background-attachment: Determines if the background scrolls with the page (scroll) or stays fixed in place (fixed).
